entries.back_en: "Did you hear that the chief of the Worens managed to escape the Castle? They say he got all the way to Wyndia!"
entries.note: Sentido preservado; 'conseguiu' adiciona leve nuance mas aceitável.

entries.back_en: "They say one of the Wyndian princesses helped that Woren chief escape! Can you imagine such a thing? How scandalous!"
It looks like you could rest here. Rest Diary Never
entries.note: 'Never mind' traduzido como 'Nunca' (never); deveria ser 'Deixa pra lá'/'Cancelar'.
